environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a VPC with public subnets. The service's security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. An Application Load Balancer forwards traffic to the task on port 8080. No network-level path filtering is applied. The container runs as root with the default Fargate platform version 1.4.0. The task role has s3:GetObject on the document bucket but the filesystem path traversal is independent of S3.
